subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Order Fulfillment Rate
description: A short lesson to help you apply Order Fulfillment Rate.

hook.text: A customer orders five items. Four arrive. That's an 80% fill rate—and a disappointed buyer.

buildup.text: Order fulfillment rate measures how often complete orders are delivered on time and in full.

discovery.text: Top performers hit 95–99% OTIF. Even 1% below target can mean thousands of unhappy customers.

twist.text: High fill rates require accurate inventory data. If the system says it's in stock but it's not, you fail.

climax.text: Walmart penalizes suppliers with low OTIF scores—docking payments for late or incomplete shipments.

punchline.text: Ship it complete. Ship it on time. Every time.
